Name: NPC Sticky
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]To go along with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38113]NPC Puppycat[/url], I've added his fiancée, Princess Sticky! [/size]

[size=4]Sticky doesn't do or say much. She's just a cheerful little pup who's happy to follow Puppycat around Pelican Town (whether he likes it or not!) [/size]

[size=4]Sticky can of course also be added as a standalone character, but she's mostly intended as an enhancement toward the Puppycat mod.[/size]

[size=4]Sprites are courtesy of bobacup's original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24701]Sticky for Dogs[/url] mod which they generously gave me permission to use, while portrait art is by me.[/size]

[size=4]SMAPI, Content Patcher, and PoohCore are required for this mod, as the sprites are larger than usual NPCs. [/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
